jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the Senior Program Manager, the Mobile Senior Services Coordinator plays a proactive role in assisting active and at-risk seniors in accessing and receiving social services that will enable them to remain independent and well supported at Housing sites designated to this program. This position serves seniors and adults with disabilities living in various housing sites in San Francisco by: providing social services, wellness activities, referrals and support In addition, applicants must be able to provide direct administrative and operational support. Candidates must be able to oversee volunteers that provide activities or paid instructors that provide zoom or onsite classes. This position is characterized by a high degree of initiative, strong organization, outreach skills, demonstrated follow-up and follow-through skills, and an ability to work with a diverse group of staff, community members, and community partners. The position also requires proficient computer skills and strong verbal and written communication ability.

**The Organization:** Bernal Heights Neighborhood Center (BHNC) is a non-profit community based multi-service agency founded in 1978. Our mission is “…to preserve and enhance the ethnic, cultural, and economic diversity of Bernal Heights and surrounding neighborhoods. We promote community action to build a just and equitable community for all. BHNC focuses on the needs of people with low and moderate incomes. We work to accomplish our mission by:

* Developing affordable housing throughout San Francisco;
* Providing linguistically and culturally responsive services to our community’s most vulnerable adults, seniors, youth, and their families;
* Developing leaders; organizing and empowering our tenants, clients, members, and allies to advocate for their needs and for the needs of the community.

BHNC has five key program areas to meet this mission: Housing Development and Rehabilitation, Senior Programs, Youth Programs, Employment Programs and Community Organizing. We serve a thousand youth, adults and seniors annually from our offices in Bernal Heights and the Excelsior. Our programs raise funds from the public sector, housing development and management, foundations, local businesses and individuals.

* One year prior experience outreach, engagement, community work preferred
* Experience with Microsoft Office Programs required, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience with Google Suite required, including but not limited to Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Drive, Google Calendar and Google Forms

jobs.title: Curriculum & Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Applies knowledge of curriculum, program requirements, and educational activities to coordinate residency education programming and program-wide curricular activities for the Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care. Coordinates and maintains program operations related to didactic scheduling, faculty development activities, and major educational events, including the Anesthesia Education Day (AED) series, graduation, and annual class retreats.

Maintains a program-wide view of resident educational activities and curriculum scheduling to identify sequencing, timing, and scheduling considerations and provide guidance to program leadership. Serves as the primary scheduling contact for the PRIMER CA-1 curriculum each summer, coordinating educational activities and schedules across participating faculty, residents, and program stakeholders.

**Department Overview**

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care ranks as one of the largest departments in the School of Medicine, with an annual budget of $207 million. The three largest components of the annual revenue budget are Funds Flow Revenue, the affiliation agreement with the city and county of San Francisco, and Extramural Funds, which together represent 85.2% or $171 million. As of 2026, the department has over 200 Faculty members, 27 Staff Physicians, 200 Staff Employees, 6 Fellows, 90 Residents, 17 Non-Faculty Academics, 13 Post Docs, and 8 Nurse Practitioners. The department also works closely with 68 Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs).

In addition to the Moffitt-Long Hospital, very active units of the department exist at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) (inpatient and outpatient, including an active trauma service); San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (inpatient and outpatient); Mount Zion Medical Center (outpatient, including 23 hour stays); Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland; the UCSF Orthopedic Institute; the Benioff Children's, Betty Irene Moore Women's and Bakar Cancer (NIH-designated Cancer Center) Hospitals; and the Bayfront Medical Building (outpatient, Center for Pain Medicine) in the Mission Bay neighborhood.

The Department now has essential roles in patient care outside of the operating rooms, with active participation in Ambulatory Care, Acute and Chronic Pain, and in the Preoperative Clinic. Since 1958, the department has been at the heart of modern anesthesia’s explosive growth, and to this day continues to have an enormous impact on surgical practice and the management of pain. The department’s research, education, and clinical care earned and have maintained reputations equal to or better than that of any institution in the world. Individual members of our faculty have had a major influence on our specialty both nationally and internationally, including NIH study sections, NIH funding, and FDA and Editorial Boards. Research activities within the department are integrated with and inform clinical practice. For many years, ours has been among the top departments in the United States for NIH research funding in anesthesia.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* A minimum of three (3) years of related experience.
* Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. Solid knowledge of graduate medical education/residency program requirements. Thorough knowledge of the medical education industry.
* Thorough knowledge of curriculum development and instructional design principles; demonstrated ability to evaluate curriculum content and advise on sequencing and timing across a multi-year training program.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale educational events (e.g., retreats, graduation, conferences, career/job fairs), including space reservations, logistics, and vendor/speaker coordination.
* Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; ability to work effectively and diplomatically with faculty, program leadership, and residents.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills; ability to support and monitor advising/mentoring relationships and hold stakeholders accountable to program goals.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical ability, and demonstrated attention to detail; ability to manage multiple concurrent scheduling and logistics projects and meet competing deadlines.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in related area.
* Experience with, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn, scheduling and educational program software and platforms.

jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Own the enterprise reporting layer**

* Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.
* Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
* Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
* Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
* Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

### **Turn the data into insight**

* Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in legal review.
* Build leading indicators and early-warning triggers so leadership sees a coverage or velocity problem 60 days out rather than in the last week of the quarter.
* Pressure-test the forecast. Deliver an independent bottoms-up call and be willing to disagree with the field's number in front of senior leaders.
* Diagnose where to reallocate capacity, headcount, and pipeline generation effort across verticals, and bring the recommendation, not just the chart.
* Produce the analysis behind strategic bets: segmentation changes, territory restructuring, pricing and packaging shifts, new vertical entry.

### **Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it**

* Own top-of-funnel reporting for Sales Development: lead conversion loops, sourced vs. influenced pipeline, meeting-to-opportunity rates, and adherence to the Sales Development Playbook.
* Champion CRM data integrity. Set and enforce completeness standards for qualification fields, next steps, close dates, and competitive tags. No insight survives a dirty pipeline.
* Work hands-on in the GTM stack: Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Clay.
* Partner with GTM Engineering to automate reporting and enrichment, and use AI aggressively to compress your own analysis cycle, e.g., signal-based enrichment, automated variance commentary, first-draft narratives for business reviews.

### **Support planning and compensation**

* Support the Director of Enterprise GTM Architecture through annual and quarterly planning: capacity modeling, territory design, headcount planning, and quota setting.
* Partner with Finance and Legal on the design and modeling of Enterprise and Sales Development commission plans, and own the reporting that tracks whether those plans are driving the intended behavior.

  

**Who you are**
---------------

* **8+ years** in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM strategy, or a highly quantitative business operations role at a high-growth B2B SaaS, PaaS, or AI infrastructure company. Time in management consulting, investment banking, or PE counts toward this when paired with in-house operating experience.
* **Analytically hands-on.** Deep Salesforce reporting fluency, strong command of at least one BI layer (Looker, Hex, Tableau, Sigma), and comfort writing SQL against a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks). You build the analysis yourself.
* **Enterprise sales fluency.** You know pipeline coverage math cold, you have worked inside a stage-gate qualification framework such as MEDDIC, and you understand what actually moves a seven-figure, multi-threaded, multi-year deal.
* **A track record of reporting people use.** You have built dashboards that changed decisions, not dashboards that nobody opens. You can tell the difference and you optimize for the former.
* **Structured under ambiguity.** You can take a vague, badly-posed question, structure it from scratch, find the root cause, and build a system that keeps it from recurring.
* **Commercially and technically curious.** You will need to speak credibly about our AI products, our differentiators, and the objections enterprise buyers raise around deployment, security, and data.
* **Persuasive with executives.** You can challenge the field's forecast with data in a room of senior leaders and keep the relationship intact.
* **Genuinely interested in using AI to do this job better,** not just to report on selling it.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in a business with a mixed revenue model (services, platform, consumption) where bookings, revenue, and recognized revenue diverge meaningfully.
* Experience supporting regulated verticals (healthcare and life sciences, financial services) or public sector, where procurement cycles and compliance gates distort the funnel.
* Experience standing up reporting for a sales development organization from scratch.

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About Overwatch Mission Critical**

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose.

**Overview**

**Scope of Work**

**1. Quality Program Oversight & Auditing**

* Audit the GC’s QA/QC Plan: Review and approve the contractor’s Quality Management Plan. Ensure they have the staff and processes to manage a hyperscale-level scope.
* Surveillance & Spot Checks: Perform independent field walks and "pothole" inspections to verify that the GC’s reporting matches the physical reality on-site.
* BIM & VDC Alignment: Ensure that field installations match the coordinated 3D models and that "clash-free" designs are maintained during high-density MEP installs.

**2. Technical System Validation (Civil, Structural, MEP)**

* **Electrical Infrastructure:** Oversee the quality of Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) systems, UPS plants, and backup generators.
* **Mechanical/Cooling:** Validate the integrity of chilled water loops, CRAH/CRAC units, and massive air-handling systems.
* **Envelope & Shell:** Ensure the "white space" is airtight and meets specific humidity and particulate requirements.

**3. Issue Management & Resolution**

* **Non-Conformance Reports (NCR):** Review all NCRs issued by the GC. For major issues, lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to ensure the defect doesn't repeat across the campus.
* **Punch List Management:** Drive the "Zero-Punch" philosophy, ensuring issues are caught during installation rather than at the end of the project.

**4. Commissioning (Cx) Liaison**

----------------

*The City of Oakland is an equal opportunity employer that values workforce diversity, inclusion, and equity. Oakland has a long history of activism around issues of justice and equity. Both oppression and this resistance to oppression have shaped the city’s historical roots and the lives of its residents to this day. As public servants in one of the most diverse cities in the nation, we strive to develop employees who understand the harm and impacts of systemic inequity to create lasting, meaningful outcomes for everyone. Oakland strives to establish an environment that embraces the richness of culture, community, and individualism of employees.*

  

The City of Oakland is seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Human Resources Operations Supervisor to perform and oversee critical HR operations that support accurate employee and position information across the organization.

  
  

This is an at-will position, exempt from the provisions of the City of Oakland Civil Service Rules (per Charter Section 902f). Exempt Limited Duration positions may not exceed a period of one year.

  
  

The Human Resources Operations Supervisor is a working supervisor who will perform technical and operational assignments while directing, reviewing, and quality-checking the work of assigned staff. The position requires the ability to balance an individual workload with responsibility for ensuring that work performed by staff is accurate, complete, timely, and consistent with established procedures and requirements.

  
  

The position plays an important role in maintaining the accuracy and integrity of HR information and records, including employee and position information that supports payroll and other City processes. The incumbent will work closely with the Finance Department and other City departments to resolve discrepancies, coordinate information, and support accurate and timely processing. While the position works closely with Finance/Payroll, it is an HR operations position within the Employment Operations Services Division of HR and has responsibility for HR processes and information that support those functions.

  
  
This position requires exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to identify errors or discrepancies that may not be readily apparent. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable performing detailed technical work, reviewing the work of others, and addressing issues to ensure the accuracy and reliability of HR information.

The City of Oakland's Human Resources Management Department (HRM) plays a critical role in supporting the City's workforce and ensuring that departments have the people, systems, and resources they need to deliver essential public services. HRM provides a broad range of human resources services, including recruitment and selection, employee and labor relations, classification and compensation, benefits, human resources operations, organizational development, and employee support.

  
  

Working in HRM means working in a complex, full-service municipal human resources environment where the work has a direct impact on City employees and the communities they serve. You will collaborate with HR professionals and City departments across a wide range of functions and have the opportunity to develop expertise in public-sector human resources while contributing to improvements in how the City manages and supports its workforce.

The Department values collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality customer service. Employees are encouraged to bring forward ideas, identify opportunities to improve processes, and work together to develop practical solutions to the challenges of serving a large and diverse municipal organization.

* **Accountable.** You take ownership of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of your work and hold yourself and others to high standards.
* **An effective working supervisor.** You can provide direction, answer questions, coach employees, review their work, and address problems while continuing to perform your own assignments.
* **Comfortable with data and systems.** You can work confidently with detailed employee and position information, HR systems, spreadsheets, and other tools used to maintain and verify records.
* **A problem solver.** When something does not look right, you are willing to investigate, ask questions, reconcile information, and follow the issue through to resolution.
* **Organized and dependable.** You can manage recurring operational work, competing priorities, and deadlines without losing sight of accuracy.
* **A clear communicator.** You can explain procedures and expectations, provide constructive feedback, and work effectively with staff, HR colleagues, Finance, and City departments.
* **Collaborative but appropriately accountable.** You can build productive working relationships with Finance and other departments while understanding that HR remains responsible for the accuracy and integrity of its own processes and information.

jobs.title: Manager, Acquisition Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The Senior Acquisition Operations Manager will be a key leader within Uber's **global** Acquisition Center of Excellence (CoE) in Delivery Commercial Operations (DCO), owning the **end-to-end design and evolution** of scalable acquisition processes across Uber's Delivery business.
  
  
This role operates at the **strategic intersection of process architecture, tooling strategy, and analytics** . The individual will define future-state acquisition processes, set global standards, and use data and field insights to prioritize initiatives, inform investment decisions, and ensure acquisition health at scale.
  
  
The Acquisition CoE's work spans three major areas of scope:

* **Lead Management** (lead ingestion, qualification & enrichment, AI-based scoring, and allocation)
* **Opportunity Management** (pipeline creation standards, opportunity lifecycle governance, stage definitions, and pipeline quality)
* **Deal Management** (pricing workflows, approvals, discounting governance, and deal execution standards)

This role will own one or more of these domains and ensure tight integration across the end-to-end acquisition lifecycle.
  
  
**What the Candidate Will Do**  
  
**Future-State Process Architecture & Ownership**

* Own the future-state design for one or more acquisition domains (Lead, Opportunity, and/or Deal Management) within the end-to-end commercial lifecycle.
* Define global process standards, principles, and guardrails while enabling regional flexibility.
* Ensure strong integration, handoffs, and data continuity across acquisition stages.

**Tooling Strategy & Business Requirements Leadership**

* Lead the definition of complex business requirements and process intent for acquisition-related tooling investments, including Salesforce and supporting systems.
* Partner closely with Product, Business Technology Engineering, and Digital Field Experience teams to shape solution design, prioritization, and sequencing.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs from design through implementation.

**Analytics-Driven Prioritization & Performance Management**

* Use acquisition funnel, pipeline, and deal data to identify systemic issues and high-impact opportunities.
* Define success metrics, KPIs, and monitoring frameworks to track acquisition health globally, including pipeline quality, velocity, and conversion.
* Partner with Insights teams to interpret trends, measure ROI, and inform continuous improvement.

**Global Stakeholder Leadership & Change Enablement**

* Act as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Strategy, Enablement, and Regional teams.
* Lead global process discovery and alignment efforts across regions and segments.
* Shape and guide change management approaches, including rollout strategy, communications, and enablement.

**CoE Leadership & Talent Development**

* Set quality standards for process design, documentation, and requirements across the Acquisition CoE.
* Mentor and guide Acquisition Operations Managers and other CoE contributors.
* Contribute to building and evolving the Acquisition CoE operating model.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7-10+ years of experience in Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Process Architecture, or Strategy & Operations
* Proven experience owning complex, cross-functional, global process initiatives
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
* Experience leading business requirements and partnering with Product and Engineering teams
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently interpret and leverage data for decision-making
* Advanced proficiency with Salesforce and GTM tooling ecosystems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in marketplace, SaaS, or global sales organizations
* Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma)
* Experience leading large-scale global process or tooling transformations
* SQL or advanced analytics experience a major plus
Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills  

  
  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

jobs.title: Administrative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Involves managing or performing the administrative services or managing the full general operations of an academic or non-academic organization(s). Administrative services include activities in finance and human resources and may also include IT, facilities, or student services. General management activities include long and short range strategic planning in determining the mission and directing all activities of multi- disciplinary departments through subordinate management staff.

**Department Description:**

Alliance Health Project (AHP) is one of six clinical divisions, and several research programs that comprise Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG) Psychiatry, the second largest of 19 clinical departments at ZSFG. The mission of the AHP is to support the mental health and wellness of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and HIV-affected communities in constructing healthy and meaningful lives. AHP is one of the oldest HIV organizations in the world and a leader in the field of HIV and mental health and behavioral health services focused on both HIV care and HIV prevention. AHP provides psychotherapy, substance use counseling, case management, support groups, psychiatry, sexual health services, clinical traineeship, and provider education and training. Our multi-disciplinary staff are a client-centered, collaborative, harm reduction-oriented team. AHP has continued to grow as a community-based clinic by anticipating and addressing the changing needs of our LGBTQ+ and HIV community members for more than 40 years. Our process of continuous improvement of service to our community includes a strong focus on cultural humility and anti-racist service provision.

AHP has an annual budget of $12 million from Federal, State and City contracts and grants, private foundations, individual donors, recharge operations, and an endowment, totaling over 40 projects; 60 full and part time staff, 5 clinical interns and over 100 volunteers per annum.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or a public health field and 8+ years of related work experience or a combination of comparable clinical education and/or experience. At least 5 years in a supervisory/lead/management role.
* Broad knowledge of the organization's processes, protocols and procedures with a focus on operations, human resources, personnel management under labor contract(s) and personnel policy.
* Ability to supervise an administrative and technical team to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Strong knowledge of abstraction and collection of patient data, QI systems, external regulations, analytics and reporting
* Detail-oriented, with the ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to quickly analyze problems, determine appropriate level of intervention, and apply effective solutions
* Demonstrated ability to effectively convey complex clinical and technical information both verbally and in writing, the ability to train and mentor direct reports, and to prepare and present various reports, documentation, analyses, and project proposals
* Working knowledge of business software and specialized applications and data management systems used in quality and performance improvement processes
* Broad knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
* Demonstrated management and conflict resolution skills to effectively lead and motivate others.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and database software, preferably Access.
* Experience with DEI principles and prior experience applying them in the work setting
* Excellent organizational, analytical and demonstrated project management abilities
* Strong working knowledge in contracts and grants
* Prior experience collaborating with DPH, DPH contracts, and relevant systems of care

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, healthcare administration, public health or related field.
* Prior work experience with HIV, LGBTQ+, and BIPOC communities
* Prior UCSF, other UC campus experience or CCSF experience
* Knowledge of UCSF Government Business Contracts, Research Management Services

We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

**Immediate Employment**

  

* + Compensation from $130,000.00 - $150,000.00
  + Company Vehicle
  + Fuel Card & Fastrak

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Fire Systems Project Manager with experience in **fire alarm installation, life safety, and low voltage construction**. Our Project Managers (PM) are responsible for the execution of low voltage system projects in accordance with project budgets, code compliance, and managing the field operations team’s work quality and work output. This position will work closely with our sales team, installation team, and clients to ensure a sound design, seamless installation, and professional commissioning of our projects. The PM is a key position for our growing team and requires attention to detail in all aspects of planning and executing projects. Customer interface and management of staff require a high degree of effective human relations. Communication skills, both verbal and written, are important aspects of the PM position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

  

* + Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  + Develop and manage project budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  + Assign tasks and manage resources to meet project goals.
  + Coordinate with internal departments, subcontractors, and vendors.

  + Conduct pre-construction, progress, and close-out meetings.

  + Review, estimate, and process change orders.

**Customer & Team Communication**

  

* + Serve as the primary customer contact for all project phases.
  + Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Service, and Field Operations teams.
  + Identify and resolve project issues or conflicts efficiently.

**Major Responsibilities Breakdown**

  

* + Customer Coordination – 30%
  + RFI, Change Order, and Material Log – 20%
  + Construction Schedule Management – 20%
  + Monthly Billing Schedule – 10%
  + Interdepartmental Coordination – 10%
  + Other Duties – 10%

**Qualifications**

  

* + Construction Management, Engineering, or related field preferred.
  + 3 - 5 years proficient installation skills and understanding of fire alarm systems
  + 3 - 5 years of project management experience in **fire alarm, life safety, DAS, MDU, or low voltage construction**.
  + Proven ability to manage projects from inception through completion.
  + Strong familiarity with project management software, methodologies, and best practices.
  + Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
  + Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  + Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  + Valid California driver’s license with a clean driving record.

**Physical and Environmental Demands:**

  

* + Sitting – Constantly (6-8 hours/daily)
  + Walking – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing on Ladder- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Bending (Neck and Waist) – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Twisting (Neck and Waist) – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Lifting 0-20 Lbs. – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Carrying 0-20 Lbs. – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)

**Benefits include:**

  

* + Medical, Dental, Vision and Life, insurance plans – employee contributions required
  + Basic Life/AD&D Insurance and Long-Term Disability Insurance – covered by the employer
  + Discounted AFLAC is available at the employee's expense
  + 401K Retirement plan
  + Vacation days, dependent on the position
  + CA Paid Sick Leave earned at the rate per CA state law requirements
  + Paid Holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and the day after, Christmas Day

The Senior Project Manager reports to the Director, Capital Program Delivery Infrastructure, and is responsible for developing, managing, and delivering of rail capital projects from capital planning, design, construction, and close out phases for the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board (Caltrain). Essential Functions & Duties:

* Develop and manage the scope, schedule, and budget of Caltrain capital projects ensuring alignment with organizational goals and project objectives.
* Provide full life-cycle leadership from project execution planning, design, procurement, construction, systems integration, commissioning, and final closeout.
* Develop and maintain the project execution plan or/and project management plan PMP and support execution strategies to effective governance, risk mitigation, quality control and successful project delivery.
* Manage and coordinate all resources necessary to deliver assigned projects, including cross function departments within Rail and external consultants, Resident Engineer, Construction Management Staff, contractors, third parties and regulatory agencies throughout the project
* Ensure Safety First and Always Core Value is implemented through life cycle of project delivery.
* Work closely with the assigned project engineer(s) to ensure that all deliverables are compliant with Caltrain standards.
* Acts as the Point of Contact with internal and external stakeholders for assigned projects. Manage coordination and communications with all involved parties, including other agencies, third parties and tenant railroads
* Provide board and executive level reporting on project status, performance metrics and critical risks.
* Manage the Designer of Record and Construction Contractor to ensure delivery of the assigned projects.
* Oversee Project contract administration, change management and claim avoidance to protect Caltrain’s interest.
* Investigate, negotiate, and resolve project issues. Identify the root cause of problems and present appropriate solutions. Escalate issues to the Delivery Directors accordingly to ensure timely resolutions.

**Examples of Essential Duties:**

* Hold project meetings and represent assigned Caltrain projects at meetings, including monthly internal project reviews.
* Identify project delivery risks and develop risk mitigations and actions. Maintain and update project Risk Register.
* Perform the following project management duties; develop the scope of work, prepare and review cost estimates; monitor and produce status reports, schedules, and budgets; monitor work in progress; approve, negotiate, and execute, funding agreements and consultant contracts, authorizing contract payments per contract.
* Prepare staff reports and presentations for Management, the Board of Directors, and other stakeholders on assigned projects.
* Develop and maintain detail project staffing plans and project organization chart.
* Perform regular project budget, cost, schedule and funding reviews.
* Approval and issuance of project work directive and invoices.
* Develop and maintain project roles and responsivities matrix.
* Perform assessment of project delivery method.
* Be responsible for Project alternative study and Value Engineering effort.
* Negotiate, resolve or escalate project issues for timely resolution.
* Work collaboratively with key stakeholders to represent Caltrain for assigned projects.
* Perform all job duties and responsibilities safely to protect oneself, fellow employees, and the public from injury or harm. Promote safety awareness and follow safety procedures to reduce or eliminate accidents.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction management or equivalent
* Minimally five years’ full-time experience in project management of Rail or Transit Capital Projects
* Certified Project Manager Certificate

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* California Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred.
* Experience in Rail Transportation or Construction Management.
* Experience in Delivery Capital Project in an operating environment.
* Possess strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Possess a California driver's license with a safe driving record.

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator, Lab Operations**
---------------------------------------

**Natera** | Entry-Level | Lab Operations

### **About Natera**

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, with diagnostic solutions spanning Women's Health, Oncology, Organ Health, and Rare Disease. Our work helps clinicians and patients make earlier, better-informed health decisions, and our teams are driven by the impact of that mission every day.

### **About the Role**

As a Project Coordinator on our Lab Operations team, you'll be the organizational backbone that keeps cross-functional projects moving. You'll support Program and Project Managers across a variety of department initiatives, handling the scheduling, documentation, and tracking that help teams deliver on time and within scope. This is an excellent entry point for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to project management in a fast-paced, science-driven environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes, and maintain action item and decision logs
* Track project deliverables and follow up on document approvals, including design control documentation, under the direction of the Program Manager
* Maintain and update project schedules and Gantt charts to keep status and timelines accurate
* Schedule and coordinate project team meetings and manage logistics so issues are resolved quickly
* Adapt to shifting priorities and support multiple projects or programs as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 0–2 years of experience in a project support, administrative, or coordination role (internships and co-ops count)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working with cross-functional teams and leadership
* Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar productivity tools, and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
* A proactive, dependable, team-oriented approach

**Nice to Have**

* Coursework or exposure to life sciences, molecular biology, or genetics
* Familiarity with project tracking concepts such as Gantt charts, action item logs, or project schedules
* Experience with tools like Confluence, Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or SharePoint

### **Work Environment**

This is primarily an office-based role. You'll use a computer keyboard, communicate by phone and video, and read printed and digital material. Occasional work outside normal business hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

*If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.*

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

For more information:  

* BBB announcement on job scams
* FBI Cyber Crime resource page

Who We Are

The San Francisco Unified School District (SFUSD) is the seventh largest school district in California, serving more than 50,000 students who speak more than 44 documented languages across 121 schools in the city of San Francisco every year. We aim for every student who attends SFUSD schools to discover his or her spark, along with a strong sense of self and purpose, and that all students graduate from high school ready for college and career, and equipped with the skills, capacities and dispositions outlined in SFUSD’s Graduate Profile. Every day in our quest to achieve this mission we provide each and every student the quality instruction and equitable support required to thrive in the 21st century.

  
  

What It Means to Work Here

The SFUSD community is unified by ourCore Values:

* Student-centered: We put students’ needs first
* Fearless: We persist through challenges
* United: We celebrate and build on each other’s strengths
* Social Justice: We stand with those most vulnerable in our community
* Diversity-driven: We respect and seek to understand each person
  

  

We are also inspired by Vision, Values and Guardrails which captures our aspirations and vision for the future of public education in San Francisco. Alongside the District’s strategic plan.SFUSD is reimagining how public education will change over the next decade to meet the dynamic future of San Francisco. We want people who are strong collaborators, skilled communicators, problem solvers and who are comfortable in a community of continuous learning.

* Collaborate with functional divisions and other project team members to identify needs, design appropriate solutions, and execute projects in a timely manner, including functional enhancements, new functionality, system integrations, and ongoing support to functional teams and users

* Work with stakeholders to communicate issues while balancing business expectations
* Lead and/or participate in client training and other implementation and change-management initiatives as part of overall project and technology deliverables
* Communicate with internal teams, stakeholders, vendors, and partners on a regular basis and ensure all parties have accurate and current information regarding project status, issues, risks, dependencies, and deliverables
  

  

**Demonstrate a Leadership Mindset**

* Identify opportunities for improving business processes through automation; prepare proposals for the consolidation and integration of systems to improve business processes in collaboration with the appropriate district workgroups
* Design and implement processes for data retrieval and analysis that identify trends and opportunities for a better experience for staff and users
* Define best practices, innovate on processes, and promote effective practices across the team and SFUSD
* Lead the strategy and implementation of technology systems toward the long-term vision for a coherent technology ecosystem focused on continuous improvement and sustainability
  

  

**Manage to Results**

* Evaluate, recommend, and implement methods to maximize the operational efficiency and effectiveness of technology systems and services that staff interact with on a daily basis
* Identify and eliminate blockers and obstacles to progress and delivery on cross-functional projects.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, People Experience
jobs.description:
Zoox is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to join our People Experience (PEx) team, serving as PEx PMO's strategic partner to our Talent Acquisition organization. This role owns the planning, reporting, and vendor infrastructure that lets Talent hire efficiently and confidently at scale — from hiring capacity models to executive reporting to our large-scale industry conference presence. We're looking for someone with strong program management skills and real Talent Acquisition operations experience who can build the systems Talent leadership relies on to make good decisions. As PEx's needs evolve, this person will also be expected to take on new projects and departments beyond Talent.

### **Responsibilities**

* Program & Project Leadership: Lead Talent Operations initiatives end-to-end — including the Referral Rewards Program, requisition administration, process improvement efforts, and tooling rollouts.
* Strategic Translation & Execution: Own enterprise Hiring Goals capacity planning methodology, translating business growth targets into concrete hiring plans in partnership with Talent leadership and HRIS.
* Event & Conference Operations: Own end-to-end planning and execution for large-scale industry conferences (e.g., CVPR), including budget, vendor management, and operational logistics — plus lighter-touch support for smaller industry events.  
  Interviewing & Enablement Support: Provide light-touch support for interview standardization (playbooks, calibration) and Talent enablement initiatives (onboarding curriculum, SOPs) as needed.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary point of contact between PEx PMO and the Talent organization, partnering closely with Recruiting leadership, HRIS, and Legal to ensure alignment across initiatives.  
  Talent Tooling & Vendor Management: Own relationships with core Talent tooling vendors (Lever, Gem, LinkedIn, ModernLoop, and others), partnering on tool roadmap decisions and budget/contract planning.
* Governance & Reporting: Own executive-facing reporting, including the Monthly Hiring Report, and partner with HRIS on data governance and quality for Talent's Workday-based reporting infrastructure.

### **Initiative-Based Responsibilities**

* Hiring Goals & Capacity Planning: Build and maintain the methodology Zoox uses to plan hiring capacity against business growth targets — one of the most complex, least-documented pieces of Talent's operating model today.
* AI in Talent: Partner with Legal/Employment Law on the responsible adoption of AI tools and processes within interviewing and recruiting — a high-sensitivity, cross-functional initiative requiring careful, thoughtful execution.

### **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of relevant program management experience, with a focus on Talent Acquisition operations, recruiting program management, or workforce/hiring capacity planning.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable operational programs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong functional expertise in recruiting/TA systems and tooling (e.g., Lever, Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent).
* Analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience building data-driven planning models.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and stakeholders.
* Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or similar functions on sensitive, high-visibility initiatives.
* Strong group facilitation and presentation skills across a variety of formats.
* Experience planning and executing large-scale conferences, corporate events, or offsites, including budget and vendor management.

If you are ready to adapt to new challenges, take on new roles as needed, and hit deadlines, we would love to hear from you. If you’re not shy about herding cats and managing chaos, then this role was made for you!

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. The People Service Delivery Lead sits at the intersection of people operations domain expertise and hands-on engineering. This role owns large-scale transformation programs end to end, and, unlike a traditional program role, also contributes to designing and building the solutions those programs depend on. jobs.title: People Service Delivery Lead
jobs.description:
The People Service Delivery (PSD) team's mission is to run a high-performing, people-focused service delivery organization. Leading with care and empathy, we develop efficient processes, systems, and programs. We aim to ensure employees feel heard and have the resources and support they need during the most important moments so that they can do their best work of their careers.The People Service Delivery Lead sits at the intersection of people operations domain expertise and hands-on engineering. This role owns large-scale transformation programs end to end and, unlike a traditional program role, also contributes to designing and building the solutions those programs depend on. This lead reads HR, payroll, and people-operations workflows fluently, identifies where the seams and inefficiencies are, and then helps architect tooling solutions that close them.Working closely with leaders across People Operations, executive sponsors, engineering, and other key XFN stakeholders, this lead challenges assumptions and the status quo to improve processes, reduce barriers, and mitigate risks. Much of the work is greenfield: problems arrive without a playbook, and this lead builds the path as they walk it. This person does not need to have the “correct” answer to everything. What matters is the ability to quickly drive the conversation toward a productive solution by bringing together the right people, process, and technology, including building a working prototype when that is the fastest way to create clarity.A key expectation of this role is to be an active driver of AI adoption and creative problem-solving in operations. This lead looks for opportunities to responsibly use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, accelerate resolution times, and enhance the employee experience while ensuring strong governance, quality, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.  
  
  

### **People Service Delivery Lead Responsibilities:**

* Own development, organization, and execution of large, complex business and operational programs from inception through delivery, with little to no oversight
* owning the program roadmap and scoping, making trade-offs to optimize time-to-release and clearly communicating goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes
* Deliver tooling that removes manual effort from people's operations workflows
* Partner with Engineering to shape system design and technical direction, translating people's operations needs into clear requirements
* Participate in design and solution reviews, holding a high-quality bar for what the team ships
* Deconstruct end-to-end employee lifecycle journeys (from hire through movement, leave, and exit) to identify seams, handoff failure points, and automation opportunities across teams and systems, then build the solutions that address them
* Drive AI-enabled operational improvements, including identifying use cases for automation, workflow optimization, knowledge management, and case deflection, balancing efficiency with employee care and quality outcomes
* Improve efficiency and quality of systems and operations through end-to-end process frameworks and optimization initiatives, and design the change management that drives adoption of new processes, systems, or tooling, including training and communication plans for all levels, locations, and XFN partners
* Partner with HR Tech, engineering teams, and vendors to identify, build, and implement appropriate technology solutions
* oversee system integration efforts and ensure a smooth transition and adoption
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate program risk proactively rather than reactively
* Move fluidly between audiences (SMEs, payroll leadership, engineering peers, and skip-level leadership), simplifying complex technical concepts for non-technical groups without losing precision, and maintaining open, candid, and trusting working relationships
* Monitor the stabilization of changes to ensure that processes and systems are executed per design

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience managing large-scale, global transformation or continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving business processes, systems, and operations, with demonstrable business results
* Domain knowledge of HR, payroll, or people-operations processes, or demonstrated experience in ramping quickly into a complex operational domain
* Experience designing or operating HR processes spanning multiple stages of the employee lifecycle (e.g., hire/onboarding, movement, leaves and time away, compensation and payroll events, and offboarding), with an understanding of how upstream decisions create downstream operational load
* Experience operating independently through ambiguity, navigating competing and shifting priorities to maintain momentum, and delivering results in a detail-oriented, highly organized manner
* Experience problem-solving using data, translating thorough examination and analysis into action
* Experience working in an XFN environment: building relationships, consensus building, and motivating teams at all levels, technical and non-technical, to get colleagues on board with the benefits of transformational change

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge and understanding of the tech and software industry's business models and core processes
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience in understanding and facilitating change in a dynamic environment: handling challenges and pushback from senior stakeholders

jobs.title: Project Manager, Design Team
jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Design Team**

**About Us**

At AlfaTech we believe in more than just engineering solutions; we believe in promoting a culture of agility, collaboration, and inclusion. As a leading consulting engineering firm, we provide thoughtful engineering design that is technologically forward thinking, innovative, and environmentally conscious, ensuring that our contribution to our built environment is flexible, sustainable, and lasting across all the market segments we serve.

  

If you're driven by a passion for engineering, innovation, and making a difference, if you thrive on challenges and adapt quickly to change, and if you are looking to be part of a dynamic team of empowered, smart, energized, professionals, then AlfaTech is the place for you.

  

**Job Summary**

As the Design Team Project Manager, you will provide a very high level of technical leadership and direction to the project team to ensure successful completion of projects. The candidate will represent the firm in all interactions with clients, contractors, and other project team members. In this role, you will oversee the complete design project team in the design of the building, including in-house mechanical, electrical plumbing, and technology systems, as well as sub-consultant team members such as architects, structural and civil engineers.

  

This is a senior-level position that requires a self-motivated individual with strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills. The successful candidate will be highly analytical, possess exceptional problem-solving skills, can multi-task, work independently, and as a productive and engaged team member in a fast-paced environment.

  

**This candidate will be required to report to our San Jose or San Francisco office on a hybrid basis.**

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Coordinate project designs, evaluations, and studies.
* Quality control review of designs prepared by others.
* Lead project team in design change management.
* Coordinate and assemble overall design team proposals, including estimating in-house engineering.
* Manage contract administration, scheduling, and costing.
* Establish project budgets and schedules.
* Track project timelines, expenditures, and project deliverables and report to client and AlfaTech Management.
* Orchestrate and lead project kick-off meetings, coordination meetings, and design review meetings for the project team.
* Manage tasks as required to ensure that work is completed on time and within budget.
* Communicate directly with clients and act as the primary point of contact for AlfaTech.
* Coordinate, support, and communicate with colleagues across disciplines.
* Lead interactions with local municipalities and with contractor teams for permitting and construction activities.
* Monitor and manage the project contracted responsibilities to ensure services provided agree with contracted services and prepare additional service requests if needed.
* Maintain client relationships through prompt response to needs and questions, initiating contact when information is needed, or delays are imminent.
* Staff oversight and mentoring.
* Capable of working in the field on a construction site.
* Arrange construction site walkthroughs and lead project team meetings.
* Ensure that the client’s specified performance criteria are met.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

*This is meant to summarize the role’s responsibilities and provide some information and structure. At AlfaTech we encourage our staff to think outside the box and explore opportunities beyond the confines of ones stated responsibilities to bring new thoughts, ideas and innovations to our company.*

  
  

**Ideal Candidate**

* Demonstrated experience as a self-directed, pro-active, and highly motivated team leader.
* Detail-orientated with high levels of Math accuracy.
* Good problem solving and decision-making skills, and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills and demonstrated ability to communicate with internal and external business partners.
* Solid knowledge of codes, standards, and construction/engineering processes.
* Proclivity for catching the error and enacting appropriate changes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Acrobat, Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, SharePoint, and Procore.
* Professional Engineer (PE) License or Architectural (AIA) License preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification preferred.
* LEED Accreditation and/or WELL Certification preferred.
* Data Center experience preferred.

  

**Essential Requirements**

* Superior interpersonal communication skills.
* Superior written communication skills.
* Experience working on large-scale design and construction projects.
* Experience working on highly technical design and construction projects such as Mission Critical, Cleanroom, or Manufacturing projects.
* Minimum of ten to fifteen years of direct experience working with an architectural firm or consulting engineering firm.
* 5 years of experience managing a team of multiple building design disciplines
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or architecture or equivalent combination of work experience and relevant education.

  

**Salary Range**

This is a hybrid role. It is anticipated that the working days in the office will be done at our San Francisco or San Jose, CA offices. The expected salary range for candidates who will work in San Francisco, CA is $130,000 - $165,000. The final offer to our new team member will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the length, breadth, and depth of experience within the job and the industry, education, etc. ATCE is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states

  

**This candidate will be required to report to our San Jose or San Francisco office on a hybrid basis.**

jobs.title: Intake Coordinator Hospice
jobs.description:
At Best Home Health Providers Inc., we've gone from treating 10 patients to thousands of patients all throughout the Bay Area and beyond in just 6 years. We've won awards for our high-quality care with patients and continue to grow rapidly. At Best, you and the patients aren't a number.

Our mission is to ensure a smooth transition for patients returning home from medical facilities by offering expert guidance throughout their recovery journey.

Are you organized, people-focused, and passionate about helping patients get the care they need? Join our team as an Intake Coordinator and play a key role in guiding patients from hospital to home. You'll be the first point of contact for patients, families, and referral partners — coordinating care, verifying coverage, and setting the foundation for an excellent home health experience.

We value teamwork, empathy, and a commitment to high-quality service, all aimed at putting patients and their families at ease during their recovery. If you are passionate about making a positive impact in patients' lives and working in a supportive and family-oriented atmosphere, we encourage you to join us in providing exceptional home health care.

**Please note that this is a Non-Exempt role at $22 to $25/hr.**

**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate referred patients and gather required documentation, including history and physicals and Face-to-Face verifications
* Verify insurance coverage and obtain prior authorizations for home health services
* Coordinate with hospital discharge planners, case managers, and clinical teams to support safe, timely transitions home
* Interview patients and families to understand home needs and build a clear picture for the care team
* Complete and maintain accurate referral records and intake documentation
* Serve as a liaison between our organization, hospitals, and insurance providers
* Track referral data, attend team meetings, and keep leadership informed of any delays in care
* Perform other duties as required for patient services

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 18 years of age
* High school diploma required; prior experience in medical administrative support preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including a professional phone presence
* Comfort with computers, data entry, and standard office software
* A friendly, professional demeanor and a talent for building strong relationships with patients, families, and referral partners
* Strong organization and the ability to juggle multiple priorities with ease
* Reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license

  
**Benefits**  

* Generous PTO Policy
* Wellness Days
* Paid Sick Days
* Paid Bereavement Leave
* Skills Training & Development
* Company Social Events
* Referral Bonus
* 401(k) With A Company Match
* Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, and Vision Options)
* FSA

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life.
