**Status:** **Part****-Time, Non-Exempt (school year end: 6/2/2027)**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**

Under the supervision of the Site Coordinator, the Program Leader is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a variety of academic and enrichment activities targeting middle school youth at the CYC Aptos Beacon Center. This includes designing curriculum and activities which incorporate skill building and project based learning that are fun and engaging for youth.

We are looking for multiple staff to teach one or more of the following enrichment activities:

* Arts (i.e. painting, drawing, crafting, etc.)
* Mixed Sports (i.e. soccer, basketball, table tennis, skateboarding, etc.)
* Performing Arts (i.e. drama, voice, dance, etc.)
* Cooking, Gardening, Cultural Arts and Exploration
* Academic Tutoring
* Career & College Awareness
* STEAM (i.e. coding, 3D printing, game design, robotics, video/music production, etc.)

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop, implement, and oversee a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for middle school aged youth.
* Provide academic tutoring and assist students with their daily homework as needed.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Create marketing strategies and promotional materials to recruit and retain youth in afterschool programs.
* Collaborate with school and Beacon staff to coordinate cultural celebrations and culminating events that builds community and celebrates youth accomplishments.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school, beacon and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or must have completed a minimum of 48 college units or passed an Instructional Aide Exam.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with ethnically diverse youth and families who have experienced poverty, crisis, trauma, and other adverse events is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multitask, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs & sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin, Spanish, or Tagalog is preferred.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

**Case Manager II - Canyon Vista**

Services onsite will be available 24 hours a day, 7 days per week.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Organization/Time management skills
* Good computer/technology skills

**Front Office Manager (Physical Therapy Clinic)**  
Rising Sun Physical Therapy | San Francisco, CA

Rising Sun Physical Therapy is looking for an experienced, patient-centered Front Office Manager to lead the team that is the welcoming face of our clinic.

Since 1992, we've cared for San Franciscans with thoughtful, individualized treatment and a whole-body philosophy of healing. Our front office is the reason patients feel calm and looked after from the moment they walk in. We're looking for a leader who takes real pride in that and can keep it running at a high standard.

**Position Details**

* Start Date: Immediate availability preferred
* Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00am–4:30pm
* Pay: $30–$34 per hour, depending on experience
* Location: In-person, San Francisco

**About the Role**  
You'll oversee the front office and own how patients experience the clinic, from the first phone call to the final bill. This role relies heavily on insurance handling: verifying coverage, managing authorizations, explaining benefits, and keeping billing accurate. Deep, hands-on experience with health insurance is essential. You'll work closely with the clinic's therapists and leadership, and your work will be visible, valued, and directly tied to how well our patients heal.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, schedule, and support the front office team, including training new hires
* Set the standard for a warm, professional patient experience at every touchpoint

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of front desk or medical office experience, including hands-on health insurance verification and billing (required)

* Strong organizational and communication skills, with genuine warmth on the phone and in person
* Ability to stay calm, prioritize, and solve problems in a busy healthcare environment

**Why Work at Rising Sun Physical Therapy**

* Be part of a clinic with a long-standing reputation for excellence in San Francisco

jobs.title: Technical Solutions & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Bizzaly helps small businesses make technology and AI work for them, without the jargon. We work with local businesses to assess their technology, select the right tools, automate routine work, and implement practical AI and software solutions.

Our clients include businesses in construction, real estate, professional services, and other industries across the Bay Area.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on technical professional who is comfortable working across small-business IT, cloud applications, integrations, automation, and application support.

Our team handles client relationships, business analysis, and strategy. You'll help turn those recommendations into working solutions.

This is not purely a help-desk role. In addition to supporting client technology, you'll help maintain and troubleshoot Bizzaly's own client-facing applications and integrations.

What You'll Do

* Set up and administer Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, cloud storage, backups, password managers, and other business tools
* Migrate email, files, users, and accounts between systems
* Configure and troubleshoot SaaS applications
* Connect accounting, CRM, scheduling, project-management, and other business systems through APIs and integration tools
* Set up AI tools and build practical automations using platforms such as Zapier or Make
* Troubleshoot integrations, data flows, APIs, and existing web applications
* Help maintain and support Bizzaly-developed client applications
* Work with cloud environments, databases, Git/GitHub repositories, and deployment tools as needed
* Diagnose basic network, server, security, and connectivity issues and identify when specialist support is required
* Document systems, credentials, configurations, and processes clearly
* Explain technology patiently and clearly to non-technical business owners

What We're Looking For

* 4+ years of hands-on technology experience
* Strong experience supporting small-business or business technology environments
* Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration experience
* Experience troubleshooting SaaS applications and integrations
* Understanding of APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and web applications
* Strong security practices when handling client systems and data
* Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technology and solve problems
* Excellent communication skills and patience with non-technical clients
* Reliability and clear communication about timelines
* Ability to occasionally visit client offices in the South Bay

Particularly Valuable

You do not need every skill below, but experience in several would be valuable:

* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Python and/or JavaScript
* React or other modern web frameworks
* SQL and/or MongoDB
* REST APIs
* Git/GitHub
* Docker and CI/CD
* QuickBooks and accounting-system integrations
* Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation platforms
* AI APIs and tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude
* CRM platforms such as Zoho, HubSpot, or Salesforce

The Person We're Looking For

You might currently be a systems engineer, application-support engineer, technical solutions engineer, full-stack developer with strong client skills, or an experienced IT professional who has moved into cloud applications and automation.

We're less concerned with your title than with your ability to figure things out, implement solutions, and explain what you've done in plain English.

Why Work With Us

* Flexible part-time schedule
* Variety: small-business technology, AI, automation, and application work
* Direct interaction with business owners
* Opportunity to help shape Bizzaly's technical capabilities
* Potential to grow into a larger technical role as Bizzaly grows

Pay: From $40.00 per hour

jobs.title: Marketplace Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About WeBox**
---------------

**The Commerce Platform for Workplaces, Delivered.**

WeBox is an AI-powered workplace commerce platform designed to make workplace food and services simple, personalized, and reliable. Through our marketplace, we provide businesses with Box Meals, Event Catering, Office Pantry solutions, and more — all supported by seamless delivery and end-to-end service.

Our platform brings together hundreds of restaurant, catering, grocery, and local partners to offer workplaces greater variety, flexibility, and convenience. By combining AI-driven personalization, customizable options, reliable fulfillment, and cost-efficient service, we are building a better way for companies to serve their teams.

**Our Mission**
---------------

**Deliver Happiness**

**Our Vision**
--------------

Build the world's #1 workplace commerce platform, powered by AI, with a long-term goal of reaching $1 billion in revenue by 2032.

We are growing quickly and looking for people who are excited to build, take ownership, and grow with us.

**About the Role**
------------------

WeBox is looking for a **Marketplace Operations Analyst** to help us build and continuously improve our Marketplace.

This is a hands-on business operations role. You will look at the Marketplace as a whole — what we sell, how we price it, which partners we work with, whether we are delivering the right quality, and where we can improve.

You will work with data, but analysis is only the starting point. We are looking for someone who can turn insights into action and take ownership of problems from discovery through resolution.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Marketplace Performance**

Understand how the Marketplace is performing and identify where we can do better.

* Analyze sales, orders, customer behavior, product performance, and profitability.
* Identify trends, issues, and growth opportunities.
* Understand what customers are looking for across both online and offline offerings.
* Recommend which products or categories we should add, expand, improve, or remove.
* Track the impact of changes and continue iterating based on results.

### **Pricing & Product Strategy**

Help us make better decisions about what we sell and how we price it.

* Review product costs, selling prices, margins, and market pricing.
* Recommend pricing adjustments based on customer demand, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Evaluate new products and categories before launch.
* Identify opportunities to improve product mix and overall Marketplace margin.
* Conduct competitive and market research when needed to support business decisions.

### **Partner & Quality Management**

Help build a partner network that delivers the right products at the right price and quality.

* Evaluate existing and potential partners based on cost, quality, reliability, and customer experience.
* Participate in partner discussions and negotiations around pricing, products, and commercial terms.
* Monitor partner and product quality through customer feedback, complaints, refunds, and operational performance.
* Identify recurring issues, understand root causes, and work with partners and internal teams to resolve them.
* Recommend when a partner or product should be improved, replaced, or removed.

### **Operations & Execution**

Make sure good ideas actually turn into results.

* Work closely with Marketplace, Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Product/Tech.
* Turn analysis and business priorities into clear actions.
* Improve Marketplace processes as the business grows.
* Identify inefficient or repetitive work and find ways to simplify or automate it.
* Follow through on projects and issues until there is a clear outcome.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 2–5 years of experience in marketplace operations, business operations, e-commerce, category management, procurement, strategy & operations, consulting, or a related field.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with business and financial data.
* Good business judgment and curiosity about why something is or is not working.
* Comfortable communicating and negotiating with external partners.
* Strong ownership and follow-through.
* Able to work across teams and move between analysis and execution.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where not every problem already has a defined process.
* Experience in food, hospitality, retail, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses is a plus.

**Why Join WeBox**
------------------

* Make an Impact
* Grow With Us
* Work With a Global Team

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Company-provided lunch
* Medical, dental & vision insurance
* 401(k)
* Quarterly team activities
* Annual team-building events

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
--------------------------------

WeBox is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

*Note:*

* *The base salary for this position will be determined based on the candidate's level of experience and qualifications.*
* *This job description offers a general overview and may not encompass all responsibilities, tasks, or skills required. Additional duties may be assigned to meet the company's evolving needs.*

If you meet the requirements and are interested in this position, please submit your application.

===========================================================

$40.00–$50.00/hour (DOE)  
Full-Time | SAGE Veterinary Centers

SAGE Veterinary Centers is seeking an experienced Veterinary Technician Learning & Development Specialist (TLDS) to support the training, development, and clinical growth of our Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.

* Facilitate Veterinary Assistant and Veterinary Technician training across multiple skill levels.
* Develop and deliver clinical in-service training and educational sessions.
* Partner with Clinical Supervisors and hospital leadership to create individualized learning and development plans.
* Support onboarding and role-specific training across hospital departments based on operational needs.

* Support continuing education programs, workshops, and hospital learning initiatives.
* Promote a positive learning environment focused on clinical excellence, professional development, and patient care.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT), Certified Veterinary Technician (CVT), Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT), or equivalent credential required.
* Advanced veterinary clinical knowledge and strong hands-on technical skills.
* Veterinary Technician Specialist (VTS) credential is a plus.
* Experience training, mentoring, precepting, or developing Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Ability to confidently perform and teach veterinary clinical skills, including patient assessment and triage, venipuncture, medication and fluid administration, CPR, and patient care.
* Strong presentation, coaching, and communication skills.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback and support employees at varying levels of clinical experience.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple training and development initiatives.
* Comfortable working independently and collaboratively with technicians, veterinarians, hospital leadership, and Learning & Development partners.

Eligible full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off, including vacation and sick time
* Life and disability insurance
* Continuing Education opportunities
* VetBloom learning and professional development resources
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee pet benefits
* Opportunities for continued professional and career development within SAGE and Ethos Veterinary Health

**About Ethos Veterinary Health**
---------------------------------

Ethos Veterinary Health, part of the NVA Group, is a network of specialty and emergency veterinary hospitals committed to advancing veterinary medicine through exceptional patient care, collaboration, education, and innovation.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Ethos Veterinary Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, competence, merit, and business need. #INDH

You are a top performer in your current role

You are radically collaborative and transparent with your peers, clients, and leadership

You enjoy succeeding as a team

You love solving problems and trying new things

You hate bureaucracy, red tape, and wasteful processes

When you see something that's broken, you fix it

"That's not my job" doesn't exist in your vocabulary

If you do not meet the qualifications listed below, but believe you are fully capable of doing this job, please apply anyway.

* **Problem-Solving Mindset:** A natural inclination to look at a messy process and figure out how to make it smoother, faster, and more efficient.

Job Summary:

The Senior Project Manager leads complex, cross-functional new product development projects for in vitro diagnostic (IVD) assays and diagnostic instrument systems in an FDA-regulated medical device environment. The Senior applies deep project management experience to anticipate and resolve complex issues, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive timely decisions and escalations with limited oversight. The Senior Project Manager partners with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical Affairs, Operations, Marketing, and external development partners to achieve business and product objectives. Key Duties:

* Develops and maintains accurate, achievable integrated project plans and timeline, including critical path, dependencies, resource needs, and key decision points; consistently communicates the plans and changes with team members and the leadership team
* Drives team ownership and commitment to project plans; proactively identifies risks, issues, and tradeoffs and recommends changes needed to meet project objectives
* Tracks, analyzes, and communicates project performance, including schedule, milestones, risks, resources, and budget, and provides clear status, forecasts, and escalations to leadership
* Ensures on-time completion project deliverables in accordance with project commitments, design control requirements, and applicable company procedures
* Leads and facilitates effective cross-functional project team, decision making, issue resolution, and alignment across functions and external partners
* Other duties as assigned

* Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering or business administration or related field required; advanced degree preferred.
* At least 7 years of project management experience leading cross-functional product development projects, including significant experience managing complex, multi-functional projects from concept through launch.
* Direct experience managing FDA-regulated vitro diagnostic (IVD) product development projects, with demonstrated responsibility for schedule, risk, resources, budget, and cross functional execution.
* Proven track record of successfully leading IVD products through FDA clearance or approval and commercial launch in the U.S. market.
* Strong working knowledge of medical device design control requirements and product development processes, including design planning, design reviews, risk management, verification and validation, transfer, regulatory submission, and launch readiness.
* Demonstrated experience with IVD products, including assay and/or diagnostic instrument development.

* Demonstrated advanced Project Management skills with proven record of practical project management experience preferably in the diagnostic field
* Demonstrate successful leadership of product development projects with significant technical, regulatory, operational, and/or cross-functional complexity.

* Excellent problem-solving and decision-support skills. Must be a self-starter, detail-oriented and able to prioritize competing demands, balance workloads and timelines and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Must be able to work independently with limited oversight while influencing and collaborating with peers, functional leaders, senior stakeholders, and external partners in a cross functional setting

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Solar Project Manager**

**About Valiss Home**

Valiss Home is a growing residential home-services company focused on delivering a better customer experience across solar, battery storage, electrical, and related home-energy services.

We are building our solar operations around clear communication, strong project management, and a high level of accountability from sale through installation and project completion.

We are looking for a Solar Project Manager who will take ownership of our customer pipeline and help make sure every project continues moving forward.

**Position Overview**

The Solar Project Manager will be responsible for managing residential solar and battery projects from the point of sale through installation, inspection, utility approval, and project completion.

This person will be the primary operational point of contact for Valiss customers and will coordinate between customers, sales representatives, installers, permitting authorities, utilities, financing partners, and internal team members.

This is not simply a scheduling position. We are looking for someone who can understand where a project is in the process, identify what is preventing it from moving forward, communicate clearly with everyone involved, and take ownership of resolving problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the active Valiss solar and battery project pipeline from sale through project completion.
* Serve as the primary customer contact after the sale.
* Provide customers with regular and proactive project updates.
* Coordinate project handoffs from the sales team into operations.
* Review new projects to confirm required documentation and information has been received.
* Work with cities, counties, permitting authorities, and utilities to resolve project issues.
* Understand and process all residential solar permitting and utility interconnection applications.
* Coordinate with installation partners and subcontractors to keep projects on schedule.
* Identify stalled projects and take action to move them forward.
* Escalate issues when projects are at risk of delay or cancellation.
* Respond to customer questions, concerns, complaints, and project disputes.
* De-escalate difficult customer situations and work toward practical resolutions.
* Coordinate with sales representatives when customer expectations or project details need clarification.
* Maintain accurate project notes, status updates, documentation, and next steps.
* Help develop and improve Valiss project-management procedures as the company grows.
* Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.
* Ensure customers receive a consistent, professional Valiss experience throughout the project.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable taking ownership of problems.

The right candidate should be able to manage many projects at different stages without losing track of details.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous residential solar project-management or solar operations experience.
* Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle.
* Experience working with solar permitting and AHJs.
* Experience with utility interconnection and PTO processes.
* Familiarity with residential battery-storage projects is a plus.
* Experience communicating with homeowners throughout construction or installation projects.
* Experience working with sales teams, installers, subcontractors, or EPC partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally.
* Ability to investigate problems and determine the next action required.
* Comfortable working with CRM, project-management, and cloud-based software systems.
* Ability to manage a high-volume project pipeline.

**The Right Person for This Role**

You may be a strong fit if you naturally ask questions like:

* What is holding this project up?
* Who owns the next step?
* Has the customer been updated?
* What does the utility still need?
* Why has the permit not been approved?
* What needs to happen to get this installed?
* What can I do today to keep this project moving?

We want someone who takes ownership rather than simply documenting that a problem exists.

**Customer Experience**

Customer communication is a major part of this position.

Solar projects involve multiple parties and can take weeks or months to complete. Customers need someone who understands their project and can clearly explain what is happening.

The Solar Project Manager will be expected to communicate proactively, set realistic expectations, respond quickly when issues arise, and help resolve disagreements before they become larger problems.

**Compensation**

**Up to $20 per hour**, depending on experience.

**Growth Opportunity**

Valiss Home is in an early growth stage, and this position will play an important role in building our project-management operation.

As project volume grows, there may be opportunities for increased responsibility within operations and project management.

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

The **Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager** will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes.

This **Manager** will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing **Alternate Submission Method (ASM)** workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.

Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity.

* Assist in the development of programming documentation and SOPs, to include routine maintenance and update of program documents

  + Provide support to CSO in efforts to increase practice “opt-in” to ASM processes
* Create and transmit ASM files to all relevant payers on an established cadence

  + Maintain annual CMS and payer submission deadlines
  + Maintain and update payer specific ASM templates annually
  + Maintain and update payer specific submission methods annually
* Reconcile ASM record submissions with payer and CMS EDS files

  + Establish routine reconciliation process with payer and CMS files
  + Integrate accepted ASM submitted diagnosis data into existing risk reporting dashboards
* Provide ongoing monitoring of provider diagnosis submission and truncation trends

  + Develop process for consistent monitoring of existing dropped diagnosis and truncation dashboards for early identification of diagnosis submission errors
* Collaborate with senior leadership and legal partners to ensure continued compliance with regulatory requirements pertaining to submission of “add” and “delete” diagnoses
* Develop a process to identify and submit diagnoses appropriately identified through routine CDI chart audits.
* Conduct annual ROI evaluation of ASM processes to include both submission of “dropped” diagnoses, and retrospective chart audit projects
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, Analytics, Operations, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience with Medicare Advantage or ACA encounter data processes and/or risk adjustment experience with a Payer, Vendor or Provider Organization
* 1+ years of X-12 837 data knowledge
* Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret complex data sets and identify key insights
* Ability to develop and present information to Senior Leadership
* Working knowledge of SQL: writing, creating and/or running queries

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal
* Business Process Reengineering (BPR): Familiarity with BPR principles and methodologies to radically redesign business processes for improved performance, efficiency, and customer satisfaction
* Medicare claims experience
* Fundamental understanding of relational databases

### **Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. As an **IES Customer Success Specialist** supporting mid-market enterprise platforms, you will drive customer retention, health, and feature adoption across a scaled, queue-routed customer portfolio. We believe customer success isn't just about answering tickets; it's about active portfolio ownership, root-cause diagnosis, and helping multi-entity businesses realize long-term value from their software. Operating within a pooled, signal-driven queue, your work protects dollar and logo retention, resolves customer risk, and ensures reliable platform adoption.

**Title**: Customer Success Manager

**Salary:** $72,500 - $78,000 per year +10% Performance Bonus

**Location**: Remote (US)

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

* **Signal-Driven Triage & Portfolio Ownership:** You will monitor automated account briefs, health score signals, and 30/60/90-day feature usage trends across a shared portfolio, stepping in when usage declines or incoming inquiries require intervention. Success is measured by logo retention rates, dollar retention percentages, and overall portfolio health metrics.
* **Consultative Discovery & Value Realization:** You will engage customers through consultative conversations, diagnosing root-cause workflow friction, removing product adoption barriers, and aligning platform capabilities to their core business goals. Success is measured by feature activation speed, continued usage metrics, and customer satisfaction scores.
* **Retention, Risk Judgment & Cross-Functional Coordination:** You will identify early churn signals, lead retention discussions, and coordinate with technical support, risk, or enterprise sales leads to resolve complex issues without abandoning customer ownership. Success is measured by successful risk mitigation, accurate escalation triage, and pipeline generation for qualified expansion opportunities.

  

* 2+ years of experience in a relationship-first Customer Success, account management, or consultative role supporting B2B SaaS platforms.
* Demonstrated experience managing a customer portfolio, with a clear understanding of retention KPIs, engagement cadences, and priority management.
* Consultative discovery skills to diagnose root causes of workflow friction rather than defaulting to quick ticket resolution.
* Proven track record of influencing customer behavior, removing feature adoption barriers, and tying ongoing platform usage directly to client value.
* Ability to recognize early churn or health decay signals from usage data and execute a proactive retention plan.
* Clear, concise, and credible communication skills to simplify software complexity and manage sensitive retention conversations.
* Skill in leveraging customer usage data, account value metrics, and health scores to prioritize daily workflow across a large account base.
* Commercial judgment to spot organic expansion and feature-attach opportunities during routine customer interactions without taking a high-pressure sales stance.

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

The Dropbox Customer Experience and Success (CXS) Team shapes how more than 700 million users and 575k teams worldwide interact with our products. We turn insights into actions, bringing empathy and expertise to every touchpoint. Our team embraces resourcefulness and curiosity, pushing boundaries—and ourselves—to improve the customer experience and ensure our customers achieve their desired outcomes with our products, leading to increased customer lifetime value, retention, and growth. Every team member contributes their unique perspective as we collaborate across the organization to amplify the customer voice. If you're passionate about bringing joy, humanity, and simplicity to how people interact with Dropbox, join our Customer Experience and Success team.

### **Virtual First**

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted.

  
Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.description:
**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Your Role**

As Latitude scales and integrates with Megaport, our current sales structure needs to evolve. We are moving away from a model where one person handles everything to a specialized Pod Model. This allows us to handle a higher volume of global customers without losing quality.

As we scale globally as part of Megaport, we’re changing how we work. We’re moving to a **"Pod Model"** where Sales, Tech, and Operations work as one, and we need an **Account Manager** to be the glue that holds it all together.

You won't just be "handling accounts." You’ll be right in the middle of the action—bridging the gap between a signed deal and a happy customer. You’ll work alongside our Sales Executives and Architects to coordinate server deployments, fix billing hurdles, and spot new ways for our international clients to grow on our platform.

If you’ve got **advanced English**, love solving puzzles, and want to see how a global cloud company actually runs from the inside, we want to talk to you.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Unblock Sales: They handle the "paperwork and chores" so the Sales team can focus 100% on closing new deals.
* Faster Delivery: They push the internal buttons to make sure customers get their servers turned on quickly, not weeks later.
* Zero Billing Drama: They fix invoice and payment issues before they become big headaches for the customer.
* Spot Easy Upgrades: Since they are close to the customer, they’ll notice when someone needs a bigger plan and flag the win.
* Order in the House: They keep our systems (CRM/Billing) clean so we actually know what’s happening as we scale.
* Sales Enablement: Act as the operational right hand for Sales Executives, managing quotes, pricing, and account updates to keep the sales cycle moving.
* Account Growth: Proactively identify expansion opportunities and suggest additional capacity or services that add tangible value to the customer’s infrastructure.
* Operational Coordination
* Project Orchestration: Coordinate server provisioning, migrations, and upgrades by working closely with internal technical teams to ensure perfect execution.
* Delivery Excellence: Track all deployments from start to finish, ensuring internal systems (CRM, tickets) stay accurate, and customers are notified of completion.
* Revenue Operations: Configure billing plans (hourly, monthly, or annual) and serve as the first point of contact for invoice queries or plan adjustments.
* Lifecycle Management: Handle account maintenance, including credits and cancellations, ensuring all changes follow company guidelines and maintain data integrity.
* The Pod Engine: Operate as a central figure in our "POD" model, collaborating daily with Sales, Solution Architects, and Ops to streamline the customer journey.
* Continuous Improvement: Follow established processes while contributing fresh ideas to help us scale more efficiently.
* Technical Mastery: Actively build your knowledge of cloud infrastructure, bare metal, and global networking services.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* Effective Communicator: You are comfortable engaging with customers and can translate internal operations into clear, professional updates.
* Meticulous Organizer: You have an eye for detail and a structured approach to work. You take pride in keeping systems accurate and ensuring no task is left unfinished.
* You are genuinely curious about the "how" behind technology. You are eager to dive into the technical and operational nuances of cloud infrastructure.
* Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced, global environments. You can manage multiple priorities without losing your focus or your sense of humor.
* Relevant Experience: A background in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales Support is a major advantage.
* Tech Industry Exposure: Previous experience at a cloud, hosting, or SaaS company will help you get up to speed quickly.
* Tool Proficiency: Experience navigating CRMs (like Salesforce or HubSpot), ticketing systems, or complex billing platforms.
* Technical Foundations: A basic understanding of how servers, cloud environments, or networking work (though we are happy to train the right person).

### **What We Offer**

* Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available
* Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program
* Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
* Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave
* Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remo

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner** to drive business requirements, product vision, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to-end delivery of software solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **business analysis, Product Ownership, requirements management, functional testing, regression testing, UAT, and test case development**.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, developers, QA teams, and project leadership to translate business needs into clear functional requirements and ensure solutions meet business and user expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as a **Product Owner / Senior Business Analyst**, representing business and user needs throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Define and maintain **product vision, roadmap, priorities, and backlog** in collaboration with stakeholders and technical teams.
* Gather, analyze, document, and validate **business and functional requirements**.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, process analysis, and gap analysis.
* Create detailed **Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and use cases**.
* Translate business requirements into actionable user stories and clearly defined acceptance criteria for development and QA teams.
* Prioritize product backlog based on business value, customer needs, dependencies, and project objectives.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, QA engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the SDLC.
* Participate in **Agile/Scrum ceremonies**, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop and execute **functional test cases and test scenarios** based on business and functional requirements.
* Perform **functional testing** to validate application functionality against approved requirements.
* Perform **regression testing** following application enhancements, bug fixes, and new releases.
* Support and coordinate **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** with business users and stakeholders.
* Create UAT plans, test scenarios, test cases, and expected results.
* Coordinate UAT execution, track defects, validate fixes, and obtain business sign-off.
* Review test results and ensure identified defects are properly documented, prioritized, and resolved.
* Perform **requirements traceability** to ensure business requirements are covered by development and testing activities.
* Work closely with QA teams to ensure adequate test coverage and alignment between requirements and test cases.
* Validate completed features against **acceptance criteria** and determine whether stories are ready for production.
* Analyze production issues and support root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to resolve functional and product-related issues.
* Prepare status reports, product documentation, release notes, and stakeholder communications.
* Support implementation, deployment, and post-production validation activities.

Required Skills & Experience

* **10+ years of experience** as a Business Analyst, Senior Business Analyst, Product Owner, or similar role.
* Strong experience working as a **Product Owner within Agile/Scrum environments**.
* Strong understanding of **SDLC, Agile methodologies, and software product development**.
* Hands-on experience with **requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and management**.
* Strong experience writing **user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, BRDs, FRDs, and functional specifications**.
* Experience with **functional testing, regression testing, and UAT**.
* Strong knowledge of **test case and test scenario creation and execution**.
* Experience coordinating UAT with business users and stakeholders.
* Experience with **defect management, validation, and resolution tracking**.
* Strong understanding of **requirements traceability and test coverage**.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical and functional specifications.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and analytical skills.
* Experience working closely with **developers, QA teams, architects, project managers, and business stakeholders**.
* Strong problem-solving and documentation skills.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Own the enterprise reporting layer**

* Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.
* Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
* Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
* Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
* Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

### **Turn the data into insight**

* Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in legal review.
* Build leading indicators and early-warning triggers so leadership sees a coverage or velocity problem 60 days out rather than in the last week of the quarter.
* Pressure-test the forecast. Deliver an independent bottoms-up call and be willing to disagree with the field's number in front of senior leaders.
* Diagnose where to reallocate capacity, headcount, and pipeline generation effort across verticals, and bring the recommendation, not just the chart.
* Produce the analysis behind strategic bets: segmentation changes, territory restructuring, pricing and packaging shifts, new vertical entry.

### **Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it**

* Own top-of-funnel reporting for Sales Development: lead conversion loops, sourced vs. influenced pipeline, meeting-to-opportunity rates, and adherence to the Sales Development Playbook.
* Champion CRM data integrity. Set and enforce completeness standards for qualification fields, next steps, close dates, and competitive tags. No insight survives a dirty pipeline.
* Work hands-on in the GTM stack: Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Clay.
* Partner with GTM Engineering to automate reporting and enrichment, and use AI aggressively to compress your own analysis cycle, e.g., signal-based enrichment, automated variance commentary, first-draft narratives for business reviews.

### **Support planning and compensation**

* Support the Director of Enterprise GTM Architecture through annual and quarterly planning: capacity modeling, territory design, headcount planning, and quota setting.
* Partner with Finance and Legal on the design and modeling of Enterprise and Sales Development commission plans, and own the reporting that tracks whether those plans are driving the intended behavior.

  

**Who you are**
---------------

* **8+ years** in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM strategy, or a highly quantitative business operations role at a high-growth B2B SaaS, PaaS, or AI infrastructure company. Time in management consulting, investment banking, or PE counts toward this when paired with in-house operating experience.
* **Analytically hands-on.** Deep Salesforce reporting fluency, strong command of at least one BI layer (Looker, Hex, Tableau, Sigma), and comfort writing SQL against a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks). You build the analysis yourself.
* **Enterprise sales fluency.** You know pipeline coverage math cold, you have worked inside a stage-gate qualification framework such as MEDDIC, and you understand what actually moves a seven-figure, multi-threaded, multi-year deal.
* **A track record of reporting people use.** You have built dashboards that changed decisions, not dashboards that nobody opens. You can tell the difference and you optimize for the former.
* **Structured under ambiguity.** You can take a vague, badly-posed question, structure it from scratch, find the root cause, and build a system that keeps it from recurring.
* **Commercially and technically curious.** You will need to speak credibly about our AI products, our differentiators, and the objections enterprise buyers raise around deployment, security, and data.
* **Persuasive with executives.** You can challenge the field's forecast with data in a room of senior leaders and keep the relationship intact.
* **Genuinely interested in using AI to do this job better,** not just to report on selling it.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in a business with a mixed revenue model (services, platform, consumption) where bookings, revenue, and recognized revenue diverge meaningfully.
* Experience supporting regulated verticals (healthcare and life sciences, financial services) or public sector, where procurement cycles and compliance gates distort the funnel.
* Experience standing up reporting for a sales development organization from scratch.

**About Overwatch Mission Critical**

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose.

**Overview**

**Scope of Work**

**1. Quality Program Oversight & Auditing**

* Audit the GC’s QA/QC Plan: Review and approve the contractor’s Quality Management Plan. Ensure they have the staff and processes to manage a hyperscale-level scope.
* Surveillance & Spot Checks: Perform independent field walks and "pothole" inspections to verify that the GC’s reporting matches the physical reality on-site.
* BIM & VDC Alignment: Ensure that field installations match the coordinated 3D models and that "clash-free" designs are maintained during high-density MEP installs.

**2. Technical System Validation (Civil, Structural, MEP)**

* **Electrical Infrastructure:** Oversee the quality of Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) systems, UPS plants, and backup generators.
* **Mechanical/Cooling:** Validate the integrity of chilled water loops, CRAH/CRAC units, and massive air-handling systems.
* **Envelope & Shell:** Ensure the "white space" is airtight and meets specific humidity and particulate requirements.

**3. Issue Management & Resolution**

* **Non-Conformance Reports (NCR):** Review all NCRs issued by the GC. For major issues, lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to ensure the defect doesn't repeat across the campus.
* **Punch List Management:** Drive the "Zero-Punch" philosophy, ensuring issues are caught during installation rather than at the end of the project.

* Own the operational framework across Sales, including workflows, processes, performance management, reporting, and cross-functional handoffs. Identify opportunities to improve how teams operate and move work through the funnel.
* Map day-to-day workflows, identify friction across processes and systems, and redesign broken workflows. Translate the desired state into clear requirements for GTM Systems and other operational partners.
* Define the core metrics and reporting frameworks used to manage Sales performance. Build and improve dashboards, scorecards, and inspection mechanisms that give leaders visibility into productivity, pipeline, conversion, and workflow adoption.
* Establish standards for data quality, process adherence, documentation, and operational health. Partner with GTM Systems and RevOps to ensure Salesforce and other GTM systems accurately support how the business operates.
* Serve as a strategic operational partner to Sales leadership, translating business goals and performance data into actionable insights and helping leaders make informed decisions around performance, capacity, pipeline, and process.
* Own the operational side of changes to processes, systems, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market strategy. Partner across teams to ensure changes are implemented effectively and adopted by the field.
* Partner with Sales leadership to create more consistent onboarding, training, workflows, and ramp experiences that help new hires become productive quickly.

**What we look for:**

* **10+ years of experience** in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations, SDR/BDR Operations, or a related GTM operations function, ideally in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
* **Strong Sales expertise:** You understand the workflows and operating rhythms of Sales organizations, including pipeline generation, lead management, qualification, routing, handoffs, forecasting, productivity, and funnel conversion.
* **Systems & data fluency:** You have deep familiarity with Salesforce and adjacent GTM systems and can connect business requirements, workflows, data, and systems. You can identify system gaps and translate solutions into clear requirements for technical partners.
* **Analytical and operational rigor:** You have built reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance metrics that leaders use to manage their businesses, and you have a strong instinct for data quality, process consistency, and operational health.
* **Change and process leadership:** You have a track record of redesigning inefficient processes and driving adoption of new workflows, systems, or ways of working. You’re also comfortable leading onboarding, training, or enablement programs when needed.

**Benefits & Perks:**

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

* Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
* Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
* Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
* 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
* A home office stipend.
* 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
* Paid parental leave.
* A local in-person meet-up program.
* Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

*(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)*

***Notice to Candidates:***

*To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our* *careers page**.*

**Strategy & Board Governance Project Manager (Temporary, 4-Month Assignment)**

**Location:** California (San Francisco Bay Area preferred)  
**Duration:** October 2026 – March 2027 (approximately 4 months)  
**Schedule:** Part-Time or Full-Time

**THE ORGANIZATION:**

As a leading national nonprofit small business lender and Treasury Department-certified CDFI, Accion Opportunity Fund provides affordable loans, free business advising, educational resources, and support networks to fuel long-term success. More than a lender, the organization champions underserved small business owners who are ready to grow, thrive, and build a better future. For over 30 years, Accion Opportunity Fund has expanded access to economic opportunity by creating pathways to both financial and knowledge capital.

For more information about us, visit https://aofund.org/

**ROLE SUMMARY:**

Accion Opportunity Fund has a large calendar of board meetings covering three different entities as well as organizational strategy and collaboration meetings. The Strategy & Board Governance Project Manager will work directly with the VP/Chief of Staff along with the CEO and Executive Team on the following:

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Project and program management of all board meetings across three entities (approximately 50 board and executive committee meetings a year)
* Content management and creation for all board meetings including communication with board members about meetings
* Management and distribution of board documents within board portal
* Scheduling, site sourcing and planning of in-person board meetings
* Weekly eTeam Meetings & Monthly All Staff meetings – plan agendas, facilitate, drive follow-ups and documentation
* CEO schedule and engagement support – external event coordination, speaking talking points, etc. (There is an Executive Assistant who manages CEO’s calendar)

Project management proven track record managing board governance and meetings for financial institutions, executive communication skills, responsiveness, high attention to detail, strong external executive partner management, flawless execution, strong familiarity with using AI for workflow/not just queries, flexibility (managing Pacific to East coast schedules and meeting times)

Is 5-15 years out of college, has worked in community, regional or other banking environments, with a strong proven track record of managing board governance. Lives in San Francisco bay area.

new_jobs.title: Commercial Roofing Project Manager/Roof Inspector
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced roofing professional to manage commercial roofing projects and document roof conditions at prospective client properties. You will give the Account Manager clear photos, field findings, and written reports to support proposals. Once work is approved, you will coordinate the project through completion. The Account Manager leads the sales process.

**Roof Observations and Reports**

· Visit prospective clients' commercial properties to observe existing roof conditions and discuss reported concerns.

· Take clear overview and detail photos; label them by building, roof area, and condition.

· Document visible roof issues, drainage concerns, relevant measurements, access needs, and existing roof materials.

· Prepare organized reports that explain observed conditions, identify recommended repairs or maintenance, and note areas needing further evaluation.

· Provide the Account Manager with reports, photos, and scope recommendations; answer technical questions during proposal preparation.

**Project Management**

· Manage approved roofing projects from planning and mobilization through final walkthrough and closeout.

· Monitor job progress, labor and material costs, workmanship, and compliance with the approved scope.

· Communicate with the Account Manager; address weather delays, site concerns, and scope changes through the company's approval process.

· Maintain progress photos and job records; coordinate punch list corrections and collect closeout documentation.

**Qualifications**

· 5 years commercial roofing experience and a working knowledge of common roof systems, repairs, maintenance, and installation practices.

· Experience working with roofing crews or projects; project manager, superintendent, foreman, estimator, or roof observer experience is valuable.

· Ability to recognize and accurately document roof conditions, take useful photos, and write clear reports.

· Strong organization, dependable follow-through, and professional communication with clients and coworkers.

· Comfort using email, mobile photo tools, and basic report or project management software.

· Valid driver's license and ability to travel between properties and safely access roofs using required safety equipment.

· Some out of State travel will be needed.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role means timely, useful roof reports; well-coordinated projects; early communication about problems; and completed work that meets the approved scope and quality expectations.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Commercial Roofing: 5 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* Driver License with clean MVR (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Santa Clara, CA 95054 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**What You'll Be Doing**
========================

**Job Scope:** Generally responsible for supervision and technical direction over a team of engineers and designers engaged in the total delivery of services on time, within performance budget and quality expectations. Work at this level requires extensive progressive experience in project management and involves the utilization of project controls for cost, schedule and quality of projects. This work will be performed under minimal supervision.

**Primary responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Efficiently managing promotional projects minimizing the cost to Hargrove by working with the Engineering Resource Leaders to accurately estimate Professional Service man-hours to complete the project while achieving the objectives.
* Successfully managing commercial contract(s) on one or more projects of various sizes, as required. Ensuring that invoices are paid in a timely manner, Project Change Notices are processed, monthly Office Earnings Report (OER) is reviewed in the time allotted, and the project(s) plan in Vision is current.
* Maintaining control of the project by tracking and maintaining discipline performance budget progress, schedule commitments, and quality standards. Understanding and utilizing the project tools that are in place for project control.
* Validating professional service and construction estimates at the beginning of a project, and then tracking changes as the project progresses.
* Participating in development of all major technical, cost, scheduling and performance decisions.
* Familiarity with project scope, specifications, deliverables required by client, and design criteria upon assignment to a project and gaining Hargrove team alignment of schedule and budget in regard to deliverables required. Work with client team to define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Recognizing and communicating scope and design changes promptly by championing the Project Change Notice process and promoting a positive Change Management culture.
* Leading the effort in building a productive Team both within Hargrove and with the client. Utilize rewards where applicable to recognize outstanding contributions.
* Coordinating resource requirements with other ongoing project work and insure all parties’ expectations are aligned.
* Planning and organizing the work of the team. Communicating the plan to your team, the project leadership team and the client. Aligning the expectations of all parties. Conduct weekly coordination meetings with the Team.
* Maintaining timely and accurate reporting including weekly and monthly reports utilizing a comprehensive action item list. Reviewing engineering documents, vendor submittals, fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, good engineering practice, and project objectives. Project Manager is responsible for ensuring all documentation is reviewed and checked against vendor submittals, specifications, interdiscipline, etc. regardless of resource location. Ensuring that standard project work processes are followed by all team members through all phases of engineering, procurement, and construction.
* Interviewing discipline leads to maintain up-to-date progress against man hour expended analysis recognizing the Project Manager is responsible for overall financial health of each project with the respective discipline leads being responsible for producing the required deliverables within the given budget.
* Assessing the performance of the project team members through the course of the project, and work with resource leadership to organize a qualified and motivated project team.
* Ensuring project documentation is properly reviewed and approved by the client.
* Providing Construction Phase Support, start-up assistance, and response to Requests for Information, as needed.
* Managing timeliness of client team decision making and package approval.
* Promoting continuing positive relations with the client building on long term relationships that continue to add additional services.
* Completing project closeout as required by the client and Hargrove work procedures. Participating in the planning of training programs, continuous education opportunities and professional development of staff.
* Effectively and proactively manage the client at all stages of the project.

Below is the range that we in good faith believe is the potential compensation for this role at the time of this posting and is only applicable for jobs to be performed in California. The typical base salary range for this position is just one component of Hargrove’s total compensation package for Teammates. Actual compensation will be based on education, experience, skill set and location.

Minimum Salary: $210,000 annually

Maximum Salary: $250,000 annually

**Ideal Background**
====================

**Education:** Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Civil Engineering from an accredited university is preferred.

**Certification:** Professional Engineering and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) registration is highly preferred.

**Experience:** This position requires 15+ years of relevant experience in engineering and project management.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Knowledge of the Hargrove project execution procedures.
* Knowledge and application of company business standards and good practices.
* Knowledge and application of company engineering standards and project controls tools.
* Demonstrated proficiency in complex project management.
* Ability to lead a team to deliver on commitments.
* A comprehensive understanding of the function of all engineering disciplines, procurement, and construction processes.
* Ability to manage client relationships in complex situations.
* Ability to relate easily to others in the busine

new_jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred
