new_jobs.title: Fire Systems Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Fire Systems Project Manager – Fire Alarm & Life Safety Construction (must have experience)**

**Immediate Employment**

  

* + Compensation from $130,000.00 - $150,000.00
  + Company Vehicle
  + Fuel Card & Fastrak

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Fire Systems Project Manager with experience in **fire alarm installation, life safety, and low voltage construction**. Our Project Managers (PM) are responsible for the execution of low voltage system projects in accordance with project budgets, code compliance, and managing the field operations team’s work quality and work output. This position will work closely with our sales team, installation team, and clients to ensure a sound design, seamless installation, and professional commissioning of our projects. The PM is a key position for our growing team and requires attention to detail in all aspects of planning and executing projects. Customer interface and management of staff require a high degree of effective human relations. Communication skills, both verbal and written, are important aspects of the PM position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

  

* + Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  + Develop and manage project budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  + Assign tasks and manage resources to meet project goals.
  + Coordinate with internal departments, subcontractors, and vendors.
  + Ensure compliance with project specifications, codes, and safety standards.
  + Maintain accurate project documentation (RFIs, submittals, change orders, equipment logs, meeting minutes).

**Scheduling & Field Coordination**

  

* + Develop construction schedules and manpower plans.
  + Conduct pre-construction, progress, and close-out meetings.
  + Interface with inspectors and ensure all permits and fees are obtained.
  + Track material deliveries and adjust schedules as needed to maintain progress.

**Financial Management**

  

* + Prepare and manage budgets, cost forecasts, and billing schedules.
  + Review, estimate, and process change orders.
  + Support positive cash flow and assist with project close-out analysis.

**Customer & Team Communication**

  

* + Serve as the primary customer contact for all project phases.
  + Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Service, and Field Operations teams.
  + Identify and resolve project issues or conflicts efficiently.

**Major Responsibilities Breakdown**

  

* + Customer Coordination – 30%
  + RFI, Change Order, and Material Log – 20%
  + Construction Schedule Management – 20%
  + Monthly Billing Schedule – 10%
  + Interdepartmental Coordination – 10%
  + Other Duties – 10%

**Qualifications**

  

* + Construction Management, Engineering, or related field preferred.
  + 3 - 5 years proficient installation skills and understanding of fire alarm systems
  + 3 - 5 years of project management experience in **fire alarm, life safety, DAS, MDU, or low voltage construction**.
  + Proven ability to manage projects from inception through completion.
  + Strong familiarity with project management software, methodologies, and best practices.
  + Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
  + Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  + Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  + Valid California driver’s license with a clean driving record.

**Physical and Environmental Demands:**

  

* + Sitting – Constantly (6-8 hours/daily)
  + Walking – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing on Ladder- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Bending (Neck and Waist) – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Twisting (Neck and Waist) – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Lifting 0-20 Lbs. – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Carrying 0-20 Lbs. – Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)

**Benefits include:**

  

* + Medical, Dental, Vision and Life, insurance plans – employee contributions required
  + Basic Life/AD&D Insurance and Long-Term Disability Insurance – covered by the employer
  + Discounted AFLAC is available at the employee's expense
  + 401K Retirement plan
  + Vacation days, dependent on the position
  + CA Paid Sick Leave earned at the rate per CA state law requirements
  + Paid Holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and the day after, Christmas Day

**Pyro-Comm Systems, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified candidates will be considered regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, genetic information, age, disability, or veteran status.**

**No Recruiters Please**

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager reports to the Director, Capital Program Delivery Infrastructure, and is responsible for developing, managing, and delivering of rail capital projects from capital planning, design, construction, and close out phases for the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board (Caltrain). Essential Functions & Duties:

* Develop and manage the scope, schedule, and budget of Caltrain capital projects ensuring alignment with organizational goals and project objectives.
* Provide full life-cycle leadership from project execution planning, design, procurement, construction, systems integration, commissioning, and final closeout.
* Develop and maintain the project execution plan or/and project management plan PMP and support execution strategies to effective governance, risk mitigation, quality control and successful project delivery.
* Manage and coordinate all resources necessary to deliver assigned projects, including cross function departments within Rail and external consultants, Resident Engineer, Construction Management Staff, contractors, third parties and regulatory agencies throughout the project
* Ensure Safety First and Always Core Value is implemented through life cycle of project delivery.
* Work closely with the assigned project engineer(s) to ensure that all deliverables are compliant with Caltrain standards.
* Acts as the Point of Contact with internal and external stakeholders for assigned projects. Manage coordination and communications with all involved parties, including other agencies, third parties and tenant railroads
* Provide board and executive level reporting on project status, performance metrics and critical risks.
* Manage the Designer of Record and Construction Contractor to ensure delivery of the assigned projects.
* Oversee Project contract administration, change management and claim avoidance to protect Caltrain’s interest.
* Investigate, negotiate, and resolve project issues. Identify the root cause of problems and present appropriate solutions. Escalate issues to the Delivery Directors accordingly to ensure timely resolutions.

**Examples of Essential Duties:**

* Hold project meetings and represent assigned Caltrain projects at meetings, including monthly internal project reviews.
* Identify project delivery risks and develop risk mitigations and actions. Maintain and update project Risk Register.
* Perform the following project management duties; develop the scope of work, prepare and review cost estimates; monitor and produce status reports, schedules, and budgets; monitor work in progress; approve, negotiate, and execute, funding agreements and consultant contracts, authorizing contract payments per contract.
* Prepare staff reports and presentations for Management, the Board of Directors, and other stakeholders on assigned projects.
* Develop and maintain detail project staffing plans and project organization chart.
* Perform regular project budget, cost, schedule and funding reviews.
* Approval and issuance of project work directive and invoices.
* Develop and maintain project roles and responsivities matrix.
* Perform assessment of project delivery method.
* Be responsible for Project alternative study and Value Engineering effort.
* Negotiate, resolve or escalate project issues for timely resolution.
* Work collaboratively with key stakeholders to represent Caltrain for assigned projects.
* Perform all job duties and responsibilities safely to protect oneself, fellow employees, and the public from injury or harm. Promote safety awareness and follow safety procedures to reduce or eliminate accidents.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction management or equivalent
* Minimally five years’ full-time experience in project management of Rail or Transit Capital Projects
* Certified Project Manager Certificate

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* California Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred.
* Experience in Rail Transportation or Construction Management.
* Experience in Delivery Capital Project in an operating environment.
* Possess strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Possess a California driver's license with a safe driving record.

Pay: $157,814.00 - $220,939.00 per year

new_jobs.title: People Service Delivery Lead
new_jobs.description:
The People Service Delivery (PSD) team's mission is to run a high-performing, people-focused service delivery organization. Leading with care and empathy, we develop efficient processes, systems, and programs. We aim to ensure employees feel heard and have the resources and support they need during the most important moments so they can do impactful work. The People Service Delivery Lead sits at the intersection of people operations domain expertise and hands-on engineering. This role owns large-scale transformation programs end to end, and, unlike a traditional program role, also contributes to designing and building the solutions those programs depend on. This lead reads HR, payroll, and people-operations workflows fluently, identifies where the seams and inefficiencies are, and then helps architect tooling solutions that close them.Working closely with leaders across People Operations, executive sponsors, engineering, and other key XFN stakeholders, this lead challenges assumptions and the status quo to improve processes, reduce barriers, and mitigate risks. Much of the work is greenfield: problems arrive without a playbook, and this lead defines the path as they walk it. This person does not need to have the “correct” answer to everything. What matters is the ability to quickly drive the conversation toward a productive solution by bringing together the right people, process, and technology, including building a working prototype when that is the fastest way to create clarity.A key expectation of this role is to be an active driver of AI adoption and creative problem-solving in operations. This lead looks for opportunities to responsibly use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, accelerate resolution times, and enhance the employee experience while ensuring strong governance, quality, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.  
  
  

### **People Service Delivery Lead Responsibilities:**

* Own development, organization, and execution of large, complex business and operational programs from inception through delivery, with little to no oversight
* own the program roadmap and scoping, making tradeoffs to optimize time-to-release and clearly communicating goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes
* Deliver tooling that removes manual effort from people operations workflows
* Partner with Engineering to shape system design and technical direction, translating people operations needs into clear requirements
* Participate in design and solution reviews, holding a high-quality bar for what the team ships
* Deconstruct end-to-end employee lifecycle journeys (from hire through movement, leave, and exit) to identify seams, handoff failure points, and automation opportunities across teams and systems, then build the solutions that address them. Drive AI-enabled operational improvement, including identifying use cases for automation, workflow optimization, knowledge management, and case deflection, balancing efficiency with employee care and quality outcomes
* Improve efficiency and quality of systems and operations through end-to-end process frameworks and optimization initiatives, and design the change management that drives adoption of new processes, systems, or tooling, including training and communication plans for all levels, locations, and XFN partners
* Partner with HR Tech, engineering teams, and vendors to identify, build, and implement appropriate technology solutions
* oversee system integration efforts and ensure smooth transition and adoption
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate program risk proactively rather than reactively
* Move fluidly between audiences (SMEs, payroll leadership, engineering peers, and skip-level leadership), simplifying complex technical concepts for non-technical groups without losing precision, and maintaining open, candid, and trusting working relationships
* Monitor stabilization of changes to ensure processes and systems are executed per design

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in managing large-scale, global transformation or continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving business processes, systems, and operations, with demonstrable business results
* Domain knowledge of HR, payroll, or people-operations processes, or demonstrated experience in ramping quickly into a complex operational domain
* Experience designing or operating HR processes spanning multiple stages of the employee lifecycle (e.g., hire/onboarding, movement, leaves and time away, compensation and payroll events, and offboarding), with an understanding of how upstream decisions create downstream operational load
* Experience operating independently through ambiguity on greenfield problems, navigating competing and shifting priorities to maintain momentum, and delivering results in a detail-oriented, highly organized manner
* Experience problem-solving using data, translating thorough examination and analysis into action
* Experience working in an XFN environment: building relationships, consensus building, and motivating teams at all levels, technical and non-technical, to get colleagues on board with the benefits of transformational change

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge and understanding of the tech and software industry's business models and core processes
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience in understanding and facilitating change in a dynamic environment: handling challenges and pushback from senior stakeholders

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Executive Development
new_jobs.description:
People Development accelerates the performance of every Metamate, team, and leader — building the capabilities, culture, and human-AI partnerships that power Meta's future. We help people thrive through continuous change, grow more valuable over time, and choose to stay. We do this through coaching, team development, leadership experiences, performance systems, and skills at scale — all working as an integrated system, not a set of disconnected programs.This individual contributor role sits on the Executive Development team, which delivers best-in-class development to Meta's senior most leaders as they forge the future at a transformational moment in the company's history. You will be responsible for the delivery, execution and operations of Executive Development experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the delivery of Executive Development programs. Serve as the participant-facing program manager once a cohort is running, including in-session presence, cohort communications, and holding the experience standard live.
* Own in-person and virtual event execution: venues, vendors, production, print and delivery, and day-of execution — so logistics are invisible to leaders.
* Produce the materials senior leader experiences depend on — briefs, run-of-show documents, journals, and participant materials — to a consistent standard against real deadlines, in place early enough that senior leader and faculty time is immediately productive.
* Drive participants to a filled, ready cohort. Issue invitations, track nominations, confirmations and declines, chase non-responses through executive assistants, and drive required inputs — assessments, pre-work, forms, and closeout surveys — to completion, documenting exceptions.
* Build the repeatable processes behind each program, documented well enough that someone new could run it, and keep program assets current, findable, and reusable cycle over cycle — so delivery never depends on who is staffed.
* Own data capture and standing reporting. Capture data at the right moments in each program and maintain the reporting and quality checks built on it.
* Project-manage design and build work toward execution — workback plans, designer and vendor coordination, decision-gate readiness, and asset production.
* Manage contingent workers and vendors against a clear brief, holding delivery quality and timelines.
* Execute communications plans — drafting, sequencing, scheduling, sending, and tracking.
* Apply AI to how the team operates — automating and compressing internal workflows, reporting, tracking, and production, including completing privacy and sensitivity review.
* Support planning with delivery evidence. Bring participant and program data into quarterly planning, maintain team meeting materials and trackers, and surface delivery risk early.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects and events as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* 4+ years of program/project management experience running programs end to end
* Demonstrated track record of delivering high-touch programs or events for senior or executive audiences, where quality and discretion are non-negotiable
* Demonstrated track record of establishing credibility in front of senior leaders — able to hold a room of executives during delivery, read it, and adjust in the moment
* Demonstrated track record of building and maintaining trackers, operating procedures, and reporting that others rely on
* Demonstrated track record of attention to detail in participant-facing materials and communications
* Experience managing complex logistics for in-person and virtual experiences, including vendors and external suppliers
* Experience applying AI tools to automate or improve operational workflows
* Experience managing, structuring, and analyzing program data
* Experience managing contingent workers or vendors to a defined brief
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity, and who stays calm when timelines compress

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Event management experience at executive level
* Project Management (PMP / PMI) certification
* Experience supporting executive assistants or executive offices
* Data analysis acumen
* Bachelor's Degree

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

new_jobs.description:
**About WeBox**
---------------

**The Commerce Platform for Workplaces, Delivered.**

WeBox is an AI-powered workplace commerce platform designed to make workplace food and services simple, personalized, and reliable. Through our marketplace, we provide businesses with Box Meals, Event Catering, Office Pantry solutions, and more — all supported by seamless delivery and end-to-end service.

Our platform brings together hundreds of restaurant, catering, grocery, and local partners to offer workplaces greater variety, flexibility, and convenience. By combining AI-driven personalization, customizable options, reliable fulfillment, and cost-efficient service, we are building a better way for companies to serve their teams.

**Our Mission**
---------------

**Deliver Happiness**

**Our Vision**
--------------

Build the world's #1 workplace commerce platform, powered by AI, with a long-term goal of reaching $1 billion in revenue by 2032.

We are growing quickly and looking for people who are excited to build, take ownership, and grow with us.

**About the Role**
------------------

WeBox is looking for a **Marketplace Operations Analyst** to help us build and continuously improve our Marketplace.

This is a hands-on business operations role. You will look at the Marketplace as a whole — what we sell, how we price it, which partners we work with, whether we are delivering the right quality, and where we can improve.

You will work with data, but analysis is only the starting point. We are looking for someone who can turn insights into action and take ownership of problems from discovery through resolution.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Marketplace Performance**

Understand how the Marketplace is performing and identify where we can do better.

* Analyze sales, orders, customer behavior, product performance, and profitability.
* Identify trends, issues, and growth opportunities.
* Understand what customers are looking for across both online and offline offerings.
* Recommend which products or categories we should add, expand, improve, or remove.
* Track the impact of changes and continue iterating based on results.

### **Pricing & Product Strategy**

Help us make better decisions about what we sell and how we price it.

* Review product costs, selling prices, margins, and market pricing.
* Recommend pricing adjustments based on customer demand, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Evaluate new products and categories before launch.
* Identify opportunities to improve product mix and overall Marketplace margin.
* Conduct competitive and market research when needed to support business decisions.

### **Partner & Quality Management**

Help build a partner network that delivers the right products at the right price and quality.

* Evaluate existing and potential partners based on cost, quality, reliability, and customer experience.
* Participate in partner discussions and negotiations around pricing, products, and commercial terms.
* Monitor partner and product quality through customer feedback, complaints, refunds, and operational performance.
* Identify recurring issues, understand root causes, and work with partners and internal teams to resolve them.
* Recommend when a partner or product should be improved, replaced, or removed.

### **Operations & Execution**

Make sure good ideas actually turn into results.

* Work closely with Marketplace, Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Product/Tech.
* Turn analysis and business priorities into clear actions.
* Improve Marketplace processes as the business grows.
* Identify inefficient or repetitive work and find ways to simplify or automate it.
* Follow through on projects and issues until there is a clear outcome.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 2–5 years of experience in marketplace operations, business operations, e-commerce, category management, procurement, strategy & operations, consulting, or a related field.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with business and financial data.
* Good business judgment and curiosity about why something is or is not working.
* Comfortable communicating and negotiating with external partners.
* Strong ownership and follow-through.
* Able to work across teams and move between analysis and execution.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where not every problem already has a defined process.
* Experience in food, hospitality, retail, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses is a plus.

**Why Join WeBox**
------------------

* Make an Impact
* Grow With Us
* Work With a Global Team

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Company-provided lunch
* Medical, dental & vision insurance
* 401(k)
* Quarterly team activities
* Annual team-building events

--------------------------------

WeBox is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Learning only creates value when it changes behavior and improves performance. As an Instructional Designer at Patriot, you will build performance-based learning experiences that help employees apply critical skills, enable leaders to reinforce those skills, and connect development efforts to measurable business outcomes.

This role partners closely with business leaders, stakeholders, and subject matter experts to identify performance needs and design scalable learning solutions that drive capability growth across the organization. You will create engaging learning journeys, practical tools, and measurable development experiences that strengthen readiness, adoption, and long-term success.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Diagnose performance needs through stakeholder interviews, learner feedback, field insights, and business data to identify root causes and recommend effective development solutions.
* Design performance-based learning journeys that include readiness activities, instruction, practice, coaching, reinforcement, and performance checkpoints.
* Create high-quality learning assets, including facilitator guides, participant materials, role-play scenarios, job aids, assessments, leader tools, and communications.
* Partner with subject matter experts and business leaders to transform technical expertise into practical, learner-centered solutions.
* Develop assessment and measurement strategies that evaluate readiness, skill application, behavior adoption, and business impact.
* Support organizational readiness and change adoption through effective communications, reinforcement plans, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Contribute to scalable learning systems by maintaining templates, standards, governance processes, and resource libraries that improve quality and consistency.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You approach learning challenges with a performance-first mindset and focus on business outcomes, not just knowledge transfer.
* You are skilled at uncovering root causes and translating complex needs into practical solutions.
* You communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders and subject matter experts.
* You balance creativity with structure and can build engaging experiences while maintaining high standards of quality and consistency.
* You are highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects, timelines, and stakeholder expectations simultaneously.
* You value feedback and continuously improve your work through data, observation, and learner insights.
* You embrace emerging technologies and leverage AI tools thoughtfully to improve efficiency, quality, and learner outcomes.

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Day One:**

* 7 to 9+ years of progressive experience in instructional design, learning experience design, talent development, or a related field.
* Demonstrated success conducting needs analyses and building practical, application-focused learning solutions for diverse audiences.
* Experience designing assessments, reinforcement strategies, and evaluation approaches tied to behavior change and business performance.
* Strong stakeholder management, project management, writing, visual design, and executive communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Articulate, Canva, presentation tools, collaboration platforms, and content development technologies.
* Deep expertise working with Learning Management Systems.
* Strong AI fluency with demonstrated experience adopting and applying AI tools to improve learning design and development.
* Ability to distinguish between knowledge transfer and true performance-based learning solutions.
* Experience collaborating with subject matter experts and leading effective design and review processes.

### **Valuable Additions:**

* Portfolio showcasing performance-based learning programs, learning journeys, and instructional design work products.
* Experience supporting revenue enablement, leadership development, talent acceleration, or organizational capability-building initiatives.
* Background designing blended learning solutions that combine instructor-led, digital, practice-based, and coaching experiences.
* Experience building measurement frameworks that connect learning outcomes to operational or business performance indicators.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, content governance practices, and scalable learning system design.
